leads.headline: Drone strike on Riyadh tower injures 11
leads.dek: Coalition blames the Houthis, who have not claimed it; most flights to Riyadh cancelled.

leads.headline: China probes Shanghai chief Chen Jining
leads.dek: Politburo member, 62, accused of serious violations; fourth Politburo figure hit since 2022.

leads.headline: Leak: at least 490,000 Russian troops dead
leads.dek: Hacked Rosstat death records, Feb 2022 to Aug 2026; the missing are not counted.

stories.headline: Court hands Senegal back AFCON title
stories.dek: CAS overturns CAF's forfeit; the 1-0 final stands. Morocco vows appeal.

stories.headline: Russian jets near island set off alert
stories.dek: About 5 warplanes enter Korea's air zone; third time in 8 days.

stories.headline: Strike kills Hamas security chief
stories.dek: Naim Abu Nahl killed by drone in a crowded street; others hurt.

stories.headline: Rights court faults Poland, Latvia
stories.dek: ECHR rules pushbacks at the Belarus border broke the ban on ill-treatment.

stories.headline: First bird-flu death tied to dairy cows
stories.dek: WHO reports 3 H5N1 cases among farm workers, one fatal; risk to public low.

stories.headline: Pakistani named for Shenzhou-24 crew
stories.dek: Zeeshan Ali set to be first foreign astronaut on a Chinese mission.

stories.headline: Nvidia slips; Anthropic below IPO price
stories.dek: Nasdaq -1.5%, Dow +0.9% as the AI rally fades a day later.

stories.headline: Solomons may drop China police pact
stories.dek: ABC says no renewal in 2027; RNZ says it is under review.

stories.headline: Military helicopter crash kills 5
stories.dek: Air force AS-532 goes down on a training flight; cause not given.

stories.headline: Congo to make miners sell local stakes
stories.dek: Decree due by January: 10% of shares for Congolese citizens.
